sarah (sec-eng): FYI found a plaintext AWS access key inside /backups/staging/db-dumps.tar.gz on the staging deploy host. Key is attached to service account 'deploy-worker'. Not high-priv but can list and get S3 objects. Starting rotation now.

mike (infra): ouch. when was the backup created? any evidence the key was used?

sarah (sec-eng): backup created 2026-03-18T03:12Z. quick grep I ran: `tar -xOf db-dumps.tar.gz | grep -n 'AKIA'` returned one hit — access_key and secret were in a legacy script. No signs of external access yet.

andrew (oncall): i'll pull CloudTrail and VPC flow logs for last 72h for that access key id. will report back in 30m.

julia (platform): we should avoid manual AWS keys. can we move this service to Vault + KMS-wrapped creds or use Vault IAM dynamic creds?

sarah (sec-eng): yes — plan: 1) revoke old key + disable service role permissions, 2) issue short-lived creds via Vault AWS secrets engine or use STS assume-role with KMS-wrapped trust, 3) update deploy-worker to fetch from Vault and use cached TTL refresh.

mike (infra): agree. for immediate mitigation: rotate the compromised access key in IAM and create a new access key with minimal policy. then update Vault secret path `secret/data/deploy/deploy-worker` with new creds and mark old as revoked.

vault-bot: audit: new write to `secret/data/deploy/deploy-worker` detected by audit-log at 2026-03-20T14:05:00Z (initiated by sarah).

andrew (oncall): CloudTrail query shows the key had 3 GetObject calls to internal staging-bucket in last 48h from 44.210.12.33 (staging deploy host). No calls from external IPs. seems internal use only.

julia (platform): that's slightly less bad but still unacceptable. we need an RBAC change: deny `s3:DeleteObject`, restrict to `s3:GetObject` for the role. Update IAM policy and pin in Terraform.

sarah (sec-eng): checklist I'm going to run now:
- revoke old access key in IAM immediately (sarh)
- create new least-priv key and push to Vault path `secret/data/deploy/deploy-worker` with KMS encryption (sarah)
- update deploy-worker config to read from Vault and rotate TTL to 1h (julia)
- add IAM policy lock to disallow wide S3 perms, PR to terraforms (mike)
- review Vault audit logs for any `kv get` from unknown principals (andrew)

mike (infra): note on KMS integration: ensure `encrypt`/`decrypt` permissions for Vault's AWS role to use the KMS key. we should also enable key rotation on that KMS key.

sarah (sec-eng): good call. we'll use our existing KMS alias `alias/redwood-vault-us-east-2` and enable automatic rotation. I'll file a small infra change to attach `kms:GenerateDataKey` and `kms:Decrypt` to the Vault role.

julia (platform): for longer term, we should migrate deploy-worker to use role assumption via STS: `sts:AssumeRole` from an instance profile or web-identity provider so no secret material ever lands in disk backups. Adding to roadmap.

andrew (oncall): quick status: revoked old key at 14:07Z, created new key 14:09Z but not active in production yet. CloudTrail alert rule for the compromised key id has been added.

mike (infra): PR opened: `infra/iam/roles/deploy-worker` with policy restricts to `s3:GetObject`+`s3:ListBucket` and denies deletes. tagging here: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/4234

sarah (sec-eng): pushed new credential into Vault at `secret/data/deploy/deploy-worker` and set `rotation_policy=1h` metadata. vault-bot audit confirms write. also added note in incident tracker: INC-2026-0319.

vault-bot: audit: key wrapping performed with KMS alias `alias/redwood-vault-us-east-2` at 2026-03-20T14:10:12Z.

julia (platform): i'll update deploy-worker config to fetch from Vault and ship a canary deploy to staging tomorrow 09:00 UTC. will add feature flag to rollout.

andrew (oncall): searching Vault audit logs: no external IPs fetched the secret; all reads by `deploy-worker-staging` principal. marking low likelihood of exfil.

sarah (sec-eng): final items: 1) double-check backups: run `grep -R 'AKIA' /snapshots/staging/*` and purge any snapshots containing keys, 2) add pre-commit hook to detect AWS key patterns in repo and build artifacts, 3) schedule a 1h postmortem tomorrow.

mike (infra): i'll add a CI job to run `detect-secrets` on build artifacts and reject artifacts with AWS key patterns.

sarah (sec-eng): timeline: rotation & IAM revoke done now. Vault write done. infra PR open. canary deploy scheduled. postmortem tomorrow 11:00am PT. tagging folks: @julia @mike @andrew. thanks all :thumbsup:

julia (platform): thanks — will follow up with runbook updates and op-doc. :white_check_mark:

andrew (oncall): closing the immediate incident ticket, leaving for postmortem.

mike (infra): noted. leaving a follow-up to rotate the KMS CMK in 90 days as part of key hygiene.

sarah (sec-eng): closing thread for now. will post postmortem link when ready.
